lock_segment: 1. Height-to-diameter ratio exactly 3.14:1 (22 cm height ÷ 7 cm width = 3.142..., rounded to 3.14:1 for precise reproducibility). 2. Top section occupies 0–15% of total height: a metallic ring with polished interior surface and brushed exterior surface, slightly tapered inward. 3. Middle section occupies 15–85% of total height: cylindrical stainless steel body with uniform brushed finish and visible vertical striations. 4. Bottom section occupies 85–100% of total height: dark brown rubber or silicone base with matte finish and fine surface scratches. 5. Lid assembly is open and unattached; consists of three concentric layers from inside out: (i) innermost circular metallic rim with reflective interior surface, (ii) middle black rubber seal encircling the inner rim, (iii) outermost threaded metallic collar with no cap present. 6. Entire surface is free of any text, pattern, logo, label, barcode, or decoration. HARD CONSTRAINTS: NO handle, NO side grip, NO carrying handle, NO strap, NO spout, NO pouring lip, NO straw, NO straw lid, NO second cap, NO flip top, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logo, NO brand mark, NO label, NO tag, NO barcode, Preserve the exact height-to-diameter ratio; do not make it shorter, wider, taller or slimmer, Keep the lid assembly's layered structure exactly as shown; do not simplify, merge or recolour its rings, Do not substitute a similar-looking item; this is the exact item from the reference.
